Game Overview

Steve and Alex Skibidi Toilet puts players into a two-player experience centered on outsmart a relentless toilet monster in a pixelated escape adventure. Choose to play as Steve or Alex, gather emeralds to unlock vibrant costumes, and employ quick reflexes to dodge danger. With its engaging retro style, this game promises an exciting blend of strategy and fast-paced action.
